brief: The portable ZVON chronometer: a palm-sized round brass instrument like a thick pocket watch, its hinged lid open; a small engraved bell emblem (the logo of a school technology club) on the lid, a mechanical year-counter window showing the four digits 2020, a row of four small round indicator lamps (amber, red, blue and white) glowing softly, a little winding crown on top and a finely engraved rim. Sturdy, hand-made 1960s engineering, no other text.
